verdict.rationale: Mastra is an agent framework with storage, memory, and threads, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only describes persisting data (thread-aware storage, durable memory, versioned datasets). It never documents retention policies, TTLs, or deletion controls. Running locally is a deployment option, not a retention or deletion capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
